name: Octavian
houseDescription: Lunar flooring, satellite gear, and rocket furniture — his interior feels like mission control with snack breaks.
description: Space-obsessed octopus with a rocket yard. Octavian is dry, dramatic, and one of only a few octopus neighbors — a longtime favorite for sci-fi cores.

acnh.intro: Octavian is a cranky octopus villager in the who appears in all games to date. His name is a pun on his species and the given name "Octavian". His catchphrase also references his species, as octopuses have suckers on their tentacles; it may also reference his cranky personality.
acnh.appearance: Octavian is a light red octopus with a jet piece standing in for a puckered mouth, puffy peach-pink cheek marks, and angry squinted eyes beneath sharp brows that give him a serious, profound expression. Two bandages cross the back of his head in an X; suckered tentacle arms and six legs make eight limbs total, true to a real octopus. Star-pattern shirts and lunar home decor nod to sci-fi Martian octopi from classic horror fiction — aliens common in Japanese pop culture — and his description leans into extraterrestrial roots, a cranky neighbor dressed like he stepped off a vintage poster for the stars.
acnh.personality: Octavian opens cranky-cold — rude edges that soften when the player keeps showing up kind, doing favors and talking often enough to earn trust. Near the beach he sometimes grows quiet, the sea stirring memories of parents and younger days he rarely shares aloud, a rare glimpse beneath the scowl.
